title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Privilege Management… (CVE-2026-101213)
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 contain an Improper Privilege Management vulnerability that allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially elevate their privileges. This vulnerability can lead to full confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact on the affected system.
